newsapp.models module¶

Database models for the News Application.

This module defines the core data model for the news platform:

  • CustomUser – an extended Django user with a role (Reader, Journalist, or Editor) and reader subscriptions.

  • Publisher – a news outlet that groups editors, journalists and articles together.

  • Article – a single news article written by a journalist, optionally linked to a publisher, and subject to editor approval.

  • Newsletter – a curated collection of articles published by a journalist.

class newsapp.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Model

A single news article.

An article is written by a journalist, may optionally belong to a publisher, and starts out unapproved. Once an editor approves it (see save()), approved_at is stamped automatically and the article becomes visible to readers.

class newsapp.models.CustomUser(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: AbstractUser

A custom user model that extends Django’s built-in user.

Adds a role field (Reader, Journalist, or Editor) which is used throughout the app and API to control permissions, plus subscription relationships so that readers can follow the publishers and journalists whose work they are interested in.

newsapp.signals module¶

Signal handlers for the News Application.

Listens for Article saves and triggers the approval side effects (subscriber emails and the internal API notification) the moment an existing article becomes approved.

newsapp.signals.handle_article_approval(sender, instance, created, **kwargs)[source]¶

Trigger notifications when an existing article gets approved.

Runs after every Article save. It only fires the notification helpers when the article is approved, has an approved_at timestamp, and was not just created (i.e. it was updated from unapproved to approved), so that brand-new drafts never trigger a notification.

newsapp.urls module¶

URL routes for the browser-facing newsapp views (articles and newsletters).

newsapp.views module¶

Views for the News Application.

Handles the browser-facing (non-API) workflows: browsing and managing articles, creating newsletters, and account registration. Also contains the two helper functions that are triggered when an article is approved: emailing subscribers and posting the approved article to the internal API.

newsapp.views.article_approve(request, article_id)[source]¶

Let an editor approve a pending article, triggering notifications.

newsapp.views.article_create(request)[source]¶

Let a journalist submit a new article, pending editor approval.

newsapp.views.article_delete(request, article_id)[source]¶

Delete an article.

The author may delete their own article; an editor may delete any article. Anyone else is redirected with a permission error.

newsapp.views.article_detail(request, article_id)[source]¶

Show the full detail view of a single approved article.

newsapp.views.article_list(request)[source]¶

List all approved articles for logged-in users.

newsapp.views.article_update(request, article_id)[source]¶

Let a journalist edit one of their own articles.

newsapp.views.home(request)[source]¶

Show the public landing page with the ten most recent approved articles.

newsapp.views.is_editor(user)[source]¶

Return True if the given user has editor privileges.

newsapp.views.is_journalist(user)[source]¶

Return True if the given user has journalist privileges.

newsapp.views.newsletter_create(request)[source]¶

Let a journalist compile a newsletter from existing articles.

newsapp.views.newsletter_list(request)[source]¶

List all newsletters, most recent first.

newsapp.views.pending_articles(request)[source]¶

Show editors the list of articles awaiting approval.

newsapp.views.post_to_api(article)[source]¶

Notify the internal API that an article has been approved.

Sends a short-timeout POST request describing the article to the site’s own /api/approved/ endpoint. Network or non-2xx failures are logged as warnings and swallowed, since this is a best-effort side effect and should never block the approval flow.

newsapp.views.register(request)[source]¶

Handle self-service account registration.

Readers and journalists may register themselves directly; anyone requesting the Editor role is downgraded to Reader, since editor accounts must be assigned by an administrator.

newsapp.views.send_approval_notifications(article)[source]¶

Email everyone subscribed to the article’s publisher or author.

Builds the set of subscribers from both the publisher’s subscriber list and the author’s personal follower list, then sends each of them a plain-text notification email. Failures for an individual recipient are logged rather than raised, so one bad address does not block the rest.
